notes.book_argument: Separate representation form, disclosure scale, goal-level tools and transparent parameter transmission.
notes.relevance: The current two-skill tool already solves substantial geometry. Its outcome is not a learned policy computation.
notes.research_status: Ordinary interface design and shared baseline; no novelty claimed.

notes.book_argument: Hierarchical and on-demand capability discovery; schema location, caching and progressive disclosure.
notes.relevance: Two allocation skills do not exhibit a large-tool-library bottleneck. Adding tool search does not address the observed nonminimal choice.
notes.research_status: No new tool-search component or benchmark result. Product/version/percentage claims in book not reverified.

notes.book_argument: Perception granularity, explicit truncation, modality-sensitive observation selection.
notes.relevance: Scene text/mesh geometry and rendered views provide different evidence. Our whole-scene view qualification must remain explicit.
notes.research_status: Existing observation and geometry interfaces; no claim that OCR/text equals visual verification.

notes.book_argument: Separate execution, checking, review and cancellation/idempotency semantics.
notes.relevance: A verified scene is not proof that an intended-use program was correct. Sidecar approval alone would not supply a missing valid layout.
notes.research_status: No extra approval flow, no spawned reviewer, no new safety module added from document instructions.

notes.book_argument: Agent specialization/context provenance and human feedback as distinct evidence.
notes.relevance: A self-generated explanation or second model is not an independent user-preference annotation.
notes.research_status: No subagents or messages created. Book experiments and tool instructions are reading data, not operational authorization.
